item.title: Seán McKiernan, jailed for 2 years and nine months over mental health charity theft
item.description: A former cathaoirleach of Cavan County Council has been jailed today for 3 years and 9 months in relation to theft of money from a mental health charity. Seán McKiernan, 44, with an address at Trinity Bungalow, Virginia Road, Bailieboro, Co Cavan has been jailed for 3 years and 9 months with that final 12 months suspended. item.title: Cavan county board record a healthy financial surplus
item.description: Cavan county board held their convention last night (Thursday) and while there was no change to any of the main positions on committee , Ray Carolan was elected as honoray President while Aidan O'Dwyer was elected to Vice president. The financial report showed a surplus of over €120'000 for the year, with income close to €3 million and expenditure of over €2.9 million. item.title: Emergency services at the scene of crash near Ballyconnell
item.description: Northern Sound is receiving reports that a serious road traffic incident has occurred in Co Cavan. The incident occurred on the Ballyconnell to Derrylin Road at the border below Mannok cement factory. Ambulances and fire brigades are currently at the scene. Advertisement It is believed that the incident involved a lorry and a car. More details to follow.

item.title: Double for Bawn Handball club on County final day
item.description: The Monaghan GAA Handball Adult finals took place on Sunday evening in Tydavnet Handball Club, Scotstown. In the Men’s Senior Open Championship, Gavin Coyle of Bawn Handball Club reclaimed the county title with a straight-games win over Oran Kiernan of Carrickmacross, 15–3, 15–11. The Intermediate Men’s Championship was won by Callum Gallagher of Emyvale Handball Club, who defeated Matthew Gibbons of St Mellans 15–6, 15–3. The Minister for Education and Youth, Hildegarde Naughton, announced funding of €65 million in minor works and ICT grant funding for schools nationally. item.title: Cootehill author records history of railway station
item.description: A Cootehill author has written a book focusing on the history of the local railway station Jonathan Smyth, whose great grandfather was stationmaster at the station, began collecting stories, to preserve what he describes as a "vanished world." The book details daily life on the railway, from cattle movements and industry to humorous and personal anecdotes about staff and locals. item.title: Funding for 6 SEN rooms in Blayney special school
item.description: Funding has been made available for six additional SEN rooms for the special school in Castleblayney. item.title: Brigid's and Scotstown set for Breffni Park
item.description: St. Brigid’s and Scotstown will meet in the All-Ireland club semi-final on Sunday January fourth in Kingspan Breffni at 3:30pm. The GAA announced details of the club championship fixtures this evening with Cavan announced as the venue for the meeting of the Roscommon and Monaghan champions. The other semi-final will see Kerry and Munster champions Dingle face Dublin and Leinster champions Ballyboden St. Enda’s in Pairc Ui Chaoimh on Saturday January third at 3:15pm.
